latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the auto-index Google Indexing API tool.
- Supports two modes: "auto-index" (fetches sitemap, submits only new URLs), and "index-now" (immediate submission or deletion of specified URLs).
- Requires a Google Cloud service account JSON key with Indexing API enabled and Google Search Console ownership.
- Caches sitemap URLs locally to avoid duplicate submissions and allows easy cache reset.
- Enforces Google Indexing API quota of 200 requests/day with built-in warning.
- Outputs detailed structured JSON results for all actions.
